mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or GDP growth is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in easing periods than in tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the federal funds rate does not lead to a significant change in S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment, or the unemployment rate is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with increasing industrial production than in periods with decreasing industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and low unemployment signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with strong GDP growth and low unemployment than in periods with weak GDP growth and high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in easing periods than in tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the federal funds rate and money supply do not lead to a significant change in S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment and strong payroll growth signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment and strong payroll growth, or the unemployment rate and payroll growth are not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with strong housing starts growth than in periods with weak housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).
